description: A `given x -> body` arm (the deprecated `->` match-arm separator) keeps its body, exactly as `given x :> body` does (S462 review F3).
rationale: §18.2: a match arm separator is `:>`, with `=>` and `->` deprecated aliases that "parse, build, and emit identically"; §42.2.3 puts `given` in a match arm. The `->` body was dropped as `({})`.
